description: Clause-pipeline semantics on the frozen Zephyr corpus: how WHERE, IN, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY, OFFSET and LIMIT compose, and what SHOW LINES does with a range and a text filter. These are DSL mechanics rather than enrichment values, so each case stacks the clauses it is about instead of testing one at a time. Four of them -- limit_does_not_falsify_the_total, limit_returns_a_prefix_of_the_unlimited_answer, offset_below_the_limit_still_fills_the_page and offset_beyond_the_limit_still_returns_a_full_page -- were known failures under the segment fetch cap and are enforced now that it is retired. Measured, with the edit that produced the numbers: put a scan-truncating early exit back at the top of the materialisation loop (break once results.len() >= limit + 1 with no ORDER BY or GROUP BY) and five cases fail -- those four, with total 4 against an answer of 1848, pages of 3 and 0 rows where 5 are asked for, and a different set of three rows entirely; plus having_after_name_order::an_unordered_page_is_chosen_by_the_predicate_too, which comes back empty. Nothing else in the suite notices, which is what makes those five the pins.

steps.fql: FIND symbols WHERE fql_kind = 'function' WHERE name = 'runq_add' IN 'kernel/sched.c'
FIND symbols WHERE fql_kind = 'function' AND name = 'runq_add' IN 'kernel/sched.c'

cases.name: order_by_line_asc_windows_the_first_five
cases.fql: FIND symbols WHERE fql_kind = 'function' IN 'kernel/sched.c' ORDER BY line ASC LIMIT 5

cases.name: order_by_name_asc_with_offset_shifts_the_window
cases.fql: FIND symbols WHERE fql_kind = 'function' ORDER BY name ASC LIMIT 3 OFFSET 5

cases.name: in_glob_scopes_the_search_and_order_by_name_picks_the_first
cases.fql: FIND symbols WHERE fql_kind = 'function' IN 'modules/hal_silabs/**' ORDER BY name ASC LIMIT 1

cases.name: group_by_kind_having_filters_the_aggregate_and_orders_by_count
cases.fql: FIND symbols GROUP BY fql_kind IN 'arch/arc/**' HAVING count >= 100 ORDER BY count DESC

cases.name: group_by_file_scoped_by_in_path_orders_by_count_desc
cases.fql: FIND symbols WHERE fql_kind = 'function' GROUP BY file IN 'subsys/**' ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 3

cases.name: find_files_orders_by_size_desc
cases.fql: FIND files WHERE extension = 'c' ORDER BY size DESC LIMIT 3

steps.fql: SHOW LINES 51-75 OF 'kernel/sched.c' WHERE text LIKE '%runq%'
SHOW LINES 51-75 OF 'kernel/sched.c' WHERE text MATCHES 'void \*\w+_runq'

cases.name: limit_does_not_falsify_the_total
cases.description: LIMIT bounds delivery, never the search. `total` is the count of everything that matched, so an agent can tell a full answer from a first page. Under the fetch cap this replaced, `total` collapsed to the page size, which reads as: this is all of it.
cases.fql: FIND symbols WHERE fql_kind = 'if' WHERE line >= 100 WHERE line <= 105 LIMIT 3

cases.name: offset_beyond_the_limit_still_returns_a_full_page
cases.description: Paging past the first page. 1848 rows match, so OFFSET 100 LIMIT 5 is an ordinary page in the middle and must hold 5 rows. Deliberately without ORDER BY: an ORDER BY sends the query down a different route, which is why every pre-existing OFFSET case in this suite missed the defect.
cases.fql: FIND symbols WHERE fql_kind = 'if' WHERE line >= 100 WHERE line <= 105 LIMIT 5 OFFSET 100

cases.name: offset_below_the_limit_still_fills_the_page
cases.description: The same defect one step smaller: the cap fetched limit+1 rows, so an OFFSET inside that window short-changed the page instead of emptying it. OFFSET 3 LIMIT 5 must return 5 rows, not 3.
cases.fql: FIND symbols WHERE fql_kind = 'if' WHERE line >= 100 WHERE line <= 105 LIMIT 5 OFFSET 3

cases.name: limit_returns_a_prefix_of_the_unlimited_answer
cases.description: A small LIMIT must return the FIRST rows of the answer, not a different sample of it. These three are the leading rows of the same query run unbounded (total 1848). Under the cap a small LIMIT opened fewer segments and returned rows that vanished when the LIMIT was raised, so sampling then widening lost what it had already shown.
cases.fql: FIND symbols WHERE fql_kind = 'if' WHERE line >= 100 WHERE line <= 105 LIMIT 3
